description: Accepts the proposed business profile and buyer questions (optionally a chosen subset of 3 to 6 question ids) and starts asking the AI engines the account includes (listed in limits.engines on GET /api/v1/me). Takes about two minutes: answers 202 Accepted with a Location header to poll until stage is finished. Safe to repeat; send an Idempotency-Key header to make a retry return the first answer. Needs login with scope reports:write.

question_ids.description: Ids of the 3 to 6 questions to ask. Omit to keep the proposed selection.

reportId.description: Report id from POST /api/v1/reports or GET /api/v1/reports.

name: start_report
title: Confirm the setup and run the report
